role: Exact recovered DirectSound driver initialization and teardown required by the source-owned sound-system lifetime. This frontier may not be replaced with successful no-ops.

startup.semantics: Allocate and checksum the exact driver block, create/configure DirectSound, initialize the listener, channel streams, voice buffers, effect images, effect/submix/impulse buffers and mutable driver defaults, publish initialized only after complete success, otherwise execute real teardown.

selectively_source_owned_calls.semantics: Reserve the aligned 0xcc-byte codec allocator block from the checksummed static sound pool and publish its unused state.

teardown.semantics: Stop active driver work, release every channel stream, voice buffer and submix, release DirectSound, release the WMA decoder, clear decoder state, and publish the driver unavailable.

blocker: The recovered lifecycle performs live DirectSound allocation, configuration, buffer playback, effect routing, and release through mutable interface objects. No successful no-op or fabricated device is permitted.
